ns2:section.sectionText: ON-CAMPUS PROGRAM GRADUATE STUDENTS SECTION A. Asynchronous online. No synchronous class meeting time/day. Canvas LMS. Enrollment restrictions notation: No late adds after start of first class without prior written permission of the professor at bmbarnet@illinois.edu. No Audits, Sit-in, Credit/No Credit, or Non-Degree enrollments. Restricted to on-campus program Graduate students with Degree status for 4 hours credit. Not for students with Freshman, Sophomore, Undergraduate Non-Degree, or Graduate Non-Degree class standing.
